subject.title: Add Cursor Cloud Agent usage attribution

question: Should CodexBar expose Cloud Agent spend attribution using Cursor's undocumented dashboard usage-events endpoint once caching and proof requirements are satisfied?
rationale: The feature adds a new user-visible provider metric whose long-term reliability depends on an undocumented first-party endpoint and event schema.

options.title: Accept after safeguards
options.body: Allow the feature after Cloud attribution is made fully live-only and real-account behavior is demonstrated.

options.title: Defer undocumented endpoint support
options.body: Keep CodexBar on the existing documented or established Cursor usage paths until a more stable attribution API exists.

recommendation.title: Accept after safeguards
recommendation.body: Allow the feature after Cloud attribution is made fully live-only and real-account behavior is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository and Cursor provider history make this the strongest available owner for the product and endpoint-stability decision.
